name: arith_sum_moebius_mul_card_divisors
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((n / d).divisors.card : ℤ) = 1
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((n / d).divisors.card : ℤ) = 1
informal: Σ_{d|n} μ(d)τ(n/d) = 1 — Dirichlet convolution μ * (ζ * ζ) = ζ, then unfold the convolution over divisorsAntidiagonal.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ↑(n / d).divisors.card = 1
